analyst.summary: Biocon delivered a genuinely improving FY26 (total income Rs 17,270 Cr, EBITDA margin up ~200bps to 22%), powered by its biosimilars franchise (~60% of revenue, +16% YoY) and helped by the resolution of its long-running Malaysia insulin-plant regulatory issue (now FDA-cleared and freshly EMA-approved) plus the completed buyout of Viatris' stake in Biocon Biologics. Reported profit remains thin (~2.2% net margin) largely because of interest and amortization on the debt taken to fund that biosimilars build-out, not weak underlying operations. A fresh but procedural USFDA observation at the Bengaluru biosimilars site (Apr-2026) and a rich headline valuation (P/E ~183x, though EV/EBITDA is a more meaningful ~22-23x) are the two watch items. We rate BIOCON Hold: improving fundamentals, but full valuation and an open regulatory item argue against adding risk at current levels.
